edges.note: THE SPONSORSHIP IS PRINTED, NOT INFERRED, AND IT IS THE TEST THAT KEEPS KING OUT OF THE PATENTS VIEW. The front page carries '(73) Assignee: The United States of America as represented by the Secretary of the Navy, Washington, DC (US)', '(74) Attorney, Agent, or Firm - Mark O Glut; NAWCAD' and 'Primary Examiner - Philip J Bonzell'. US 3,322,374 by contrast carries no assignee line at all.
